candidate_clauses.title: Canonical profile subject
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies one bounded, versioned configuration as its canonical subject.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Every ASR-001 profile.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Findings become misleading when an activity, product, event, company, and deployment are collapsed.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Object lock is the precondition for interpreting every other disclosure.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Ambiguity is recorded as unresolved rather than broadened silently.

candidate_clauses.title: Related-object boundary
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies secondary related objects and states which findings do not transfer to them.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Whenever secondary objects, organizations, platforms, activities, or events are referenced.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Evidence about one configuration is often generalized to an entire platform or sport.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Explicit boundaries prevent scope inflation.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unknown relationships remain unknown.

candidate_clauses.title: Operating context
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes the deployment context, location, participant setting, temporal state, and intended use.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Every profile.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: The same technical system can operate as contest, training, rehabilitation, research, or entertainment.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Context determines applicability and interpretation.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unpublished configuration details are marked not evidenced.

candidate_clauses.title: System roles and dependencies
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile lists system roles and material technical, institutional, equipment, and organizational dependencies.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Every profile; empty roles are not permitted.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Role and dependency changes can alter the meaning of a profile.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Profiles remain configuration-specific only when dependencies are visible.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Dependency availability can be unknown or version-limited.

candidate_clauses.title: Performance window
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile defines the interval during which actions can materially affect the evaluated result or support outcome.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Human Performance Agency or performance-dependent result is claimed.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Agency cannot be attributed without defining when performance occurs.
candidate_clauses.rationale: The performance window separates live performance from prior design or later analysis.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: If the window cannot be bounded, the agency finding remains disputed or unknown.

candidate_clauses.title: Agency modes and segments
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes active agents, assistance, autonomy, and phase-level handoff when control changes.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: More than one agency mode exists or control varies by phase or regime.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Summary labels conceal human-machine handoff and causal contribution.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Agency Segments preserve observed control without pretending to solve causal attribution.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Permitted control modes are not presented as observed transitions without evidence.

candidate_clauses.title: Performance interface channels
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes the channels through which human action or intention enters the system.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Human performance is part of the profiled configuration.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Interface mediation changes what counts as observable performance and failure.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Interface description prevents remote, assisted, tracked, and biological channels from being collapsed.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unclear or proprietary interface behavior is marked not evidenced.

candidate_clauses.title: Embodied demand and biological control
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes evidenced bodily, physiological, sensorimotor, cognitive, or adaptive demands without assigning an embodiment score.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: The profile makes an embodiment, athletic, physiological, or biological-control claim.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Visible movement is not the only performance channel, while any biosignal is not automatically athletic embodiment.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Channel-based disclosure preserves diversity without inventing a universal threshold.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: BCI and other disputed channels retain unresolved category relation.

candidate_clauses.title: Arena configuration
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes physical, computational, and unified arenas, rule-bearing zones, and tracking volumes relevant to the configuration.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Every profile; non-spatial support contexts can state not applicable for specific arena elements.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Physical spatial skill, display mediation, and computationally constituted space are often confused.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Arena disclosure anchors Operational Spatial Integration claims.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Absent public technical detail is preserved as not evidenced.

candidate_clauses.title: Distributed-arena relation
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes topology, shared state, synchronization, sites, remote operators, calibration relation, officiation, and responsibility when distributed operation is claimed.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: More than one physical site or remote-control relation is material.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Remote control, remote synchronous competition, co-location, and remote supervision are different integrity conditions.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Explicit topology prevents global availability from being mistaken for remote synchronous integrity.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Technical values remain not evidenced when no authoritative source exists.

candidate_clauses.title: Rule and constraint sources
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies the authoritative rules, constraints, versions, and responsible bodies used by the configuration.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Rules, eligibility, task constraints, or contest procedures govern the configuration.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Declared rules can diverge from the operative software or deployment.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Rule provenance supports integrity and correction.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unavailable operative rules are disclosed rather than inferred from marketing.

candidate_clauses.title: Operative rule execution
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes whether constraints are applied through people, equipment, sensors, geometry, software, or combinations.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: A rule-bearing or constraint-bearing mechanism exists.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Textual rules alone do not reveal how the contest or task actually operates.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Implementation disclosure exposes divergence and failure paths.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Opaque code can be recorded as partially evidenced.

candidate_clauses.title: Observation and estimation boundary
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile distinguishes directly measured state, inferred state, calculated state, and provider-declared state.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Sensing, tracking, physiological measurement, or state estimation is used.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Inference is frequently presented as direct measurement.
candidate_clauses.rationale: The distinction is necessary for interpreting measurement and failure.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Undisclosed algorithms remain not evidenced.

candidate_clauses.title: Sensing failure and uncertainty
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes known loss, drift, occlusion, latency, decoder, or state-estimation limitations and their effect on the profile subject.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Sensing, tracking, or state estimation is material.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Profiles that list sensors without failure behavior overstate certainty.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Failure disclosure connects technical conditions to integrity without creating a score.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unknown failure characteristics remain unknown.

candidate_clauses.title: Metric and calibration disclosure
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies each material metric, unit, source, calibration basis, uncertainty, and intended use.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: A metric, measurement, ranking, assessment, or quantitative claim is presented.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Identically named metrics can be produced under incompatible conditions.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Metric provenance is necessary before comparison.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unavailable calibration information is not converted into zero quality.

candidate_clauses.title: Comparability conditions
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile states the equipment, version, environment, classification, adaptation, network, and procedural conditions under which a comparison is intended.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Two or more performances, systems, sessions, or results are compared.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Comparability is engineered and object-specific.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Explicit conditions prevent unqualified equivalence claims.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Partial comparability remains a valid state.

candidate_clauses.title: Officiation and decision authority
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies human, automated, operator, and hybrid decision authorities, including correction or appeal paths where they exist.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: A contest, result, penalty, therapeutic decision, or formal outcome is present.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Software decisions and human authority are often conflated.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Authority disclosure supports accountability.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: No appeal process is recorded as absent or not evidenced, not invented.

candidate_clauses.title: Outcome and consequence structure
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes the evaluated outcome, openness, ranking or support result, and derived consequence structure.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: A result or consequential support process exists.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Contest consequence and clinical or training consequence are different.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Consequence remains descriptive and derived rather than a score.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Non-contest systems can mark outcome openness not applicable.

candidate_clauses.title: Spatial function claims
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies each claimed Operational Spatial Integration function and links it to a mechanism, affected object, evidence, and significance.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: The profile claims computationally mediated space represents, enables, mediates, constrains, measures, compares, or officiates.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Use of XR, 3D, telemetry, or immersion does not establish operational spatial integration by itself.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Function-level claims preserve discrimination without a spatiality score.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Disputed or partial functions remain explicit.

candidate_clauses.title: Spatial function failure effects
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes how failure or removal of each constitutive or supportive spatial function changes the configured activity or result.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: An Operational Spatial Integration function is claimed.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Feature lists do not show whether the function is incidental, supportive, or constitutive.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Failure effects test the operational nature of the claim.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: When failure effects are unknown, the claim remains limited.

candidate_clauses.title: Actor-role disclosure
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies performers, coaches, officials, operators, supervisors, spectators, developers, and other material actors.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Every profile.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Actor presence does not establish Performance Agency or authority.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Role separation prevents attribution errors.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unclear roles remain unresolved.

candidate_clauses.title: Participatory actor relation
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes external actors who materially alter resources, constraints, information, triggers, or supervision without performing.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: A non-performing actor materially affects the configured process.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Spectator, engineer, or therapist influence can be constitutive without becoming Performance Agency.
candidate_clauses.rationale: The relation preserves agency and governance boundaries.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Materiality can remain disputed.

candidate_clauses.title: Safety, accessibility, and human-limit disclosure
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile records known hazards, accessibility conditions, body variation, adaptive equipment, fatigue, collision, cybersickness, cognitive demand, and relevant limitations.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Every profile records applicable disclosures or a justified not-applicable state.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Silence about safety or access can be mistaken for absence of risk or universal usability.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Disclosure supports responsible interpretation without certifying safety.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unknown hazards remain unknown and clinical claims retain their evidence class.

candidate_clauses.title: Operational responsibility and limitations
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies responsible parties for deployment, safety controls, access decisions, supervision, and known limitation management.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Operational responsibility is material to participation or support use.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Technical capability descriptions often omit who manages human risk and access.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Responsibility disclosure separates documentation from approval.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unassigned responsibility is recorded explicitly.

candidate_clauses.title: Claim classification and source linkage
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile assigns a claim class and traceable evidence record to each material factual or analytical claim.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Every material claim in the profile.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Provider claims, sourced facts, synthesis, and interpretation are routinely mixed.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Claim separation is the core trust function of the profile.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unsupported claims remain attributed or not evidenced.

candidate_clauses.title: Uncertainty and limitation states
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile preserves supported, partial, absent, disputed, unknown, not applicable, and not evidenced states with a stated basis.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Every profile.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Binary completeness encourages false certainty.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Uncertainty is a valid output rather than a failed score.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unknown is never inferred as absence.

candidate_clauses.title: Governance, version, and responsible authority
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies the responsible profile publisher, system authority, rule or software versions, review date, and material commercial relationships.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Every profile.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Profiles become stale or conflicted when ownership and versions are hidden.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Governance metadata supports accountability and independence.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unknown authority is disclosed.

candidate_clauses.title: Correction and supersession
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile records substantive corrections, affected fields or clauses, reason, evidence, date, and supersession relation.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Every profile supports lifecycle correction, even when no correction has occurred.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Silent overwrite destroys the evidence trail.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Append-only correction strengthens reference trust.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: No-correction history is distinguishable from unavailable history.

candidate_clauses.title: Profile identity and metadata
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile has a stable identifier, profile version, creation and revision dates, language, status, subject identifier, and applicable ASR Working Draft version.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: Every profile.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Machine and human consumers cannot reliably compare unidentified profile instances.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Stable metadata enables citation, correction, and exchange.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Draft status remains visible.

candidate_clauses.title: Machine-readable distribution and licensing
candidate_clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies machine-readable distributions, serialization version, validation status, license or reuse notice, and extension namespaces when provided.
candidate_clauses.applicability_condition: A structured distribution, API, JSON, RDF, CSV, or equivalent is supplied.
candidate_clauses.problem_addressed: Structured data can become ambiguous or legally unclear without version and reuse metadata.
candidate_clauses.rationale: Distribution metadata supports reliable reuse without converting research licensing into third-party relicensing.
candidate_clauses.uncertainty_handling: Absent structured distribution is not a profile-quality score.
